defect: The new GetDataOwnership flushes the append state but never unpins the partitioned data, so the handed-off collections stay fully pinned (KEEP_EVERYTHING_PINNED) and cannot be evicted.
reason: The fix replaces the bare FlushAppendState in GetDataOwnership, a function this change added, with UnpinData (flush plus Unpin), as Finalize already did; the Destroy/Combine edits are refactors.

defect: The Windows out-of-line definition of LocalFileSystem::ListFiles repeats the default argument 'FileOpener *opener = nullptr' that the header declaration already has, a redefinition of a default argument that fails to compile.
reason: The fix removes exactly that default argument added by this change; seeing that it is a compile error requires the header declaration.

defect: The new inline virtual GetStatistics returns unique_ptr<BaseStatistics> in a header where BaseStatistics is only incomplete, which breaks single-file compilation.
reason: The fix moves GetStatistics out of line into base_file_reader.cpp and includes base_statistics.hpp there; the include situation is only visible in other files.

defect: The new HUGEINT fetchone path passes a const char* to PyLong_FromString, which takes a non-const char* on Python 2, so the Python 2 build fails to compile.
reason: The fix only adds a (char*) cast to the line this change added; knowing that it fails needs the Python 2 C API signature.

defect: This commit adds a relation-API class named JoinRelation in the duckdb namespace that clashes with the optimizer's struct JoinRelation used here (including the newly added EXPRESSION_GET branch), breaking the amalgamation build.
reason: The fix renames the optimizer type to SingleJoinRelation at every use, including the line this change added; the clash is only visible with the new main/relation/join_relation.hpp.

defect: The fix generalizes CastIsInvertible to rank timestamp precisions, adding TIMESTAMP_MS->TIMESTAMP and making casts to TIMESTAMP_S/MS/NS invertible only from less precise types.
reason: The change's addition (TIMESTAMP_SEC->TIMESTAMP invertible) is kept by the fix; the wrong results for targets TIMESTAMP_S/MS/NS came from the pre-existing default return true.

defect: LeftRightOptimizations swaps the children of any LOGICAL_ANY_JOIN regardless of join type (breaking LEFT/SEMI any joins) and flips LEFT comparison joins to RIGHT even when a right_projection_map is set.
reason: The fix restricts the any-join swap to INNER/LEFT-with-type-flip and requires an empty right_projection_map, both in the function this change added.

defect: The rewritten pass-through loop uses 'OperatorNeedsRelation(op->type)' where the old code continued while the operator was NOT one of those types, inverting the condition.
reason: The fix adds the missing negation to the loop condition this change wrote; the inversion is plain from the removed lines.

defect: In the new AddColumnIds the parameter column_ids shadows the member, so 'column_ids = std::move(column_ids)' self-assigns and the member is never set.
reason: The fix writes this->column_ids in the method this change added.

defect: The new field-type computation walks indexes from indexes[0] (the innermost field) on the column's top-level struct type, the reverse of the nesting order, giving the wrong type or an out-of-range child.
reason: The fix walks the indexes from back to front; the ColumnIndex loop in the same function already shows that indexes[0] is the deepest field.

defect: The new SliceInPlace writes at source_offset+i and reads at target_offset+i (roles swapped), so Slice with a non-zero source offset writes past the new mask and copies the wrong bits.
reason: The fix swaps the offsets back (Set(target_offset+i, other.RowIsValid(source_offset+i))) and fixes Slice's call; the old loop in the diff shows the intended direction.

defect: The change calls the char*-returning Utf8Proc::Normalize(data, len) and converts the result to std::string, leaking the malloc'ed buffer on every call.
reason: The fix frees the returned buffer; seeing that the new overload returns owned memory needs utf8proc_wrapper.hpp.

defect: The new lock_configuration check rejects RESET of every option, including schema and search_path, which USE and normal session work depend on (issue #8624).
reason: The fix replaces the blanket check this change added with CheckLock, which exempts schema and search_path; the consequence for USE needs other files.

defect: The new duckdb_string_t_data takes duckdb_string_t by value and returns a pointer into it, which dangles for inlined strings once the call returns.
reason: The fix changes the parameter to a pointer; inlining is documented by duckdb_string_is_inlined right above in the same header.

defect: The change replaces '#if defined(_WIN32) && !defined(__MINGW32__)' with '#ifdef _WIN32' for DUCKDB_API, so MinGW builds now get dllimport/dllexport and fail.
reason: The fix restores the MinGW exclusion on the DUCKDB_API line after a MinGW 64-bit failure; the removal is in the diff.

defect: GetDescription's return type becomes py::list although the implementation returns py::none() when there is no result, so description raises instead of returning None.
reason: The fix changes the return type to Optional<py::list>; the None return is in pyconnection.cpp.

defect: ConvertDictToSelVec drops result_offset and indexes defines and the filter by row_idx alone, so dictionary pages read at a non-zero result offset use the wrong define levels and filter bits.
reason: The fix restores result_offset in both lookups; Read in the diff writes defines at define_out + result_offset with a non-zero offset.

defect: The new debug block asserts D_ASSERT(entry) in TableBinding::Bind although bindings without a standard entry are legal, so debug builds abort.
reason: The fix wraps the checks in if (entry); the old '!entry ||' assertion and its comment in the diff show entry may be null.

defect: The new public, unsynchronized ColumnData::statistics is merged by concurrent appends and updates and read elsewhere without a lock, a data race.
reason: The fix makes statistics private behind a mutex with Set/Merge/GetStatistics; the racing writers are in column_data.cpp.

defect: The new DataTable::GetStatistics copies columns[column_id]->statistics without a lock while other threads merge into it.
reason: The fix routes the read through the locked ColumnData::GetStatistics; the concurrent merges are in column_data.cpp.

defect: TransformVersionNumber reads Child<IdentifierParseResult>(1) of a list, which does not match the grammar 'VersionNumber <- Identifier' added in the same commit, so INSTALL ... VERSION is not transformed correctly.
reason: The fix changes the grammar to 'VERSION' IdentifierOrStringLiteral and the transformer to match; the mismatch needs the grammar file.

defect: Adding the cast moved the parenthesis, so the assertion compares against pow(2, n) - 1 instead of pow(2, n - 1) and fails in debug builds.
reason: The fix restores pow(2, neighbors.size() - 1); the removed line shows the original expression.

defect: The change removes the per-row scan that located the failing row and sets line_error only in the comma-separated float cast, so date-format (and other) cast errors report the batch start line.
reason: The fix threads line_error through TryCastDateVector; the removed scan and the new error_line formula are both in the diff.

defect: LineInfo::GetLine now clears current_batches, so a second erroring thread passes CanItGetLine early and computes its line from incomplete lines_read, giving a wrong line or 'Missing batch index'.
reason: The fix replaces the clear with a done/first_line latch; CanItGetLine and the missing-batch throw are right next to the added clear.

defect: The new LineInfo has no record of an error already reported, so when an earlier batch's thread throws without leaving current_batches, a later erroring thread spins forever in CanItGetLine.
reason: The fix adds done/first_line to this struct and a line_error argument to GetLine; the busy-wait that hangs is in read_csv.cpp and base_csv_reader.cpp.

defect: The new ToNamedParameters emits keys read_csv does not accept or misreads ('skip_rows', 'date_format', 'timestamp_format'), so ReadCSVRelation's re-bind fails or loses options.
reason: The fix renames them to 'skip', 'dateformat' and 'timestampformat'; the accepted names are in read_csv.cpp.

defect: The new loop feeds every user option through SetReadOption, which does not handle options such as columns, names, types, all_varchar or normalize_names, so they are rejected or ignored before sniffing.
reason: The fix replaces the loop with FromNamedParameters, which handles those options; what SetReadOption accepts is in csv_reader_options.cpp.

defect: The new PushdownWindow pushes a filter below the window when it matches the partition of any single window expression (and FilterIsOnPartition is a stub returning true), which is wrong when other window expressions are not partitioned on that column.
reason: The fix pushes a filter only if every window expression is partitioned on it, rewriting the per-expression loop this change added.

defect: The templated Append is declared without a primary definition and with no bool specialization (plus a duplicate double declaration), so calls such as Append<bool> fail to link (R package).
reason: The fix gives the primary template a throwing body and removes the duplicate declaration, both lines this change added; the failing call sites are in the R package.

defect: The rewritten GetChunkInternal advances lhs_idx in the for loop and after a full result even while the current key's RHS chunk or leaf scan still has matches, pairing remaining matches with the wrong LHS row; rhs_chunk is also not reset per LHS chunk.
reason: The fix replaces the for loop with explicit first_row/lhs_idx advancing and resets rhs_chunk, all in the code this change wrote.

defect: The test reads the uninitialized total_cardinality and cur_rows_read after the loop when the loop body never ran (undefined behaviour, spurious failures).
reason: The fix initializes both variables to 0, a defect in the test lines this change added (test-only).

defect: RegisterExceptions imports the 'exceptions' module and its StandardError, which exist only in Python 2, so module initialization fails on Python 3.
reason: The fix removes the import and registers Error without that base; the Python-2-only module is evident in the diff.

defect: In the new sort-key FIRST/LAST Update, the second loop checks validity at assign_sel[i] without mapping it through idata.sel, so NULLs in non-flat inputs are detected wrongly.
reason: The fix maps the index through idata.sel before the validity check; the first loop in the same function does that mapping.

defect: The default-value copy builds its selection vector from default_idx, already resolved through the default vector's own selection, and VectorOperations::Copy applies that selection again, so non-flat default vectors yield wrong values.
reason: The fix uses row_idx in the selection; seeing the double mapping requires knowing that Copy resolves the source's own selection.

defect: The change adds D_ASSERT(flag_bytes != 0) in FlushGroup, which is false for a group holding a single value (no flags written), so debug builds abort on valid data.
reason: The fix removes that assertion as wrongful; that one-value groups have zero flag bytes depends on the flag buffer code.

defect: Next passes collection.segments[current_segment_idx] to FinalizePinState after NextScanIndex has already advanced current_segment_idx, so the pins go to the wrong (or out-of-range) segment.
reason: The fix passes the segment index saved before NextScanIndex; the reference update is visible in the same if condition.

defect: append_to_primary_key_with_transaction checks that the table count equals its own i+1 while other threads insert concurrently, so the test fails spuriously.
reason: The fix compares against the count read at the start plus i+1, a race in the test lines this change added (test-only).

defect: The new EnumTypeInfoTemplated constructor checks validity at i instead of the selected index idx.
reason: The fix changes RowIsValid(i) to RowIsValid(idx) on the line this change added; the mismatch with data[idx] is visible.

defect: The parser now adds a row at a newline only if column > 0 or try_add_line, and the final state likewise, so single-column CSVs never emit rows or lose their last value (#5566).
reason: The fix adds the single-column case to both conditions this change wrote.

defect: 'state.parent.max_row - this->start' underflows when the row group starts beyond parent.max_row, so MinValue returns count and rows past max_row are scanned.
reason: The fix guards start > max_row with 0 in both scan initializers this change modified.
